title: nnxyz nifty faces #34
observations: A large oval head shape fills most of the white canvas, outlined in thick black, with two asymmetrically placed eye forms: one upper-left drawn with tight dark spirals, one lower-right rendered as a yellow-rimmed oval.
A wide open mouth sits left of center, its lips outlined in deep red and black, with jagged gray-white zigzag lines suggesting teeth inside a black interior.
Crossing lines in cyan, magenta, yellow, lime green, white, and brown layer densely across the face and spill beyond the head outline, with no single color dominating the surface.
reading: The head tilts slightly, giving the two eye forms different heights and weights. The open mouth pulls attention left while the yellow-rimmed eye anchors the right, splitting the face into competing focal zones. Dense crossing lines cover the surface without settling into calm — the result reads as high tension rather than stillness. The white background keeps the form from dissolving into its own noise.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #25
observations: A rounded face shape is built from dense, outward-spiking white and pale-blue lines that radiate from the center, filling most of the canvas and dissolving the edge of the head into the background.

A wide open mouth with thick black outlines and white rectangular teeth sits in the lower half of the face; red and dark-crimson lines cluster around the lips, contrasting with the pale surrounding marks.
The warm-toned background—looping orange, yellow, and tan lines on brown—runs behind and through the radiating face marks, so figure and ground share the same line weight and feel continuous.
reading: The face is less a contained form than an outward burst: pale lines spike in every direction, making the boundary between face and background hard to fix. A wide, tooth-filled mouth anchors the lower half with hard black outlines, while the eyes above are nearly lost in the same radiating tangle. The effect reads as overwhelming exuberance, though the near-erasure of the eyes gives that feeling an unsettled edge.

title: nnxyz nnotb #253
observations: A large rounded form fills most of the canvas against a pale blue-grey ground, with a wide open mouth showing a row of teeth outlined in gold-yellow zigzag stitching across the lower half.
The right side carries a single large spiral eye ringed in dark red and yellow; the left side holds a smaller, squinting eye shape with horizontal striped fill — both sit above the mouth.
Short zigzag and sawtooth lines in yellow, red, pink, blue, and green run along edges and down a column below the mouth, layering over each other in distinct parallel bands.
reading: A pale, close-cropped form pushes to the edges of the frame, leaving little open space. The two eyes are built from entirely different marks — one a tight spiral, one a flat stripe — giving the face an off-balance quality. Gold zigzag stitching traces the mouth like a seam under pressure. The layered sawtooth bands below read as something held together rather than settled.

title: Wobbler
observations: Two mismatched eyes dominate the face: the left is a large dark-outlined oval filled with blue and rainbow stripes, while the right is a smaller teal rectangle with a pale iris.
A wide open mouth at the bottom shows vertical white teeth separated by dark lines, framed by a heavy blue jaw outline and flanked by pink marks at the corners.
The teal background is crossed by loose vertical strokes in lavender, orange, and magenta, with a bright magenta curve sweeping along the right edge behind the head.
reading: The two eyes refuse to agree—one swollen and ringed in black, the other boxed and watchful—giving the face a lopsided alertness that can read as startled or unsteady. Teeth bared in a wide rectangle of a mouth push the expression toward alarm rather than aggression. Warm yellows and oranges pile across the forehead while cool teal holds the edges, splitting the face between heat and calm. The title "Wobbler" fits: nothing here sits level.

title: nnxyz nnotb #53
observations: A solid black four-legged animal form arches its back sharply upward, outlined in light blue, and balances on a single black circle at the bottom center of the image.
The face shows two concentric-spiral eyes and a row of white zigzag teeth rendered as a jagged open line across the left side of the head.
The amber-yellow background is covered edge to edge in dense dark-red wavy horizontal lines, filling every gap around the figure.
reading: The black figure holds an extreme arched pose—back bowed high, one limb raised—while balanced on a single sphere, a position that reads as either alarm or display. Spiral eyes and bared zigzag teeth push the face toward something between comic and unsettling. The dark-red wave-lines packed across the yellow field press in from all sides, making the surrounding space feel charged rather than open.

title: nnxyz nnotb #284
observations: A four-legged animal form occupies the center against a flat teal field; its body is outlined in black with a lowered head at right and an arched spine rising to a curved neck at upper left.
Looping lines in yellow, red-orange, and white run along the torso and neck, while pale blue pooling shapes sit beneath the hooves.
A zigzag white line traces the top of the curved neck, and loose red lines at upper left end in small circular loops, hanging free of the main body outline.
reading: The animal reads as burdened or braced — head dropped, spine arched, legs planted wide. Warm looping lines layered across the body suggest exposed inner workings rather than surface decoration. The white zigzag ridge along the neck adds a raw, almost sutured quality. Blue pooling beneath the feet gives the figure a sense of standing in something it cannot move through.

title: nnxyz rawblocks #54
observations: A large rounded head-like form fills the frame, split vertically by a pale olive-brown stripe on the left and a darker gray field on the right.

Two circular eye-like shapes contain concentric rings; the left one is larger with yellow-green tones and white zigzag marks at its rim, while the right sits lower and is ringed in pink and dark lines.
A wide open mouth at the bottom shows a row of white block-shaped teeth outlined in red, with heavy black scribbled lines forming the jaw and surrounding area.
reading: The face-like form feels compressed—thick black outlines press the shape inward against a muted brown ground that offers little open space. Two eye-like circles, each fringed with small white fang marks, read as watchful and uneasy. A vertical color divide splits the head into mismatched halves, producing lopsided tension. The exposed teeth below widen the impression of something caught mid-howl.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #108
observations: A large dark-red heart shape sits at the center-upper face, outlined in white and filled with deep crimson, with two yellow crossed bars cutting across it.
The face is built from blocky rectangular forms in orange, yellow, and dark red, set against a mid-gray background with a loose purple arc behind the head.
A wide open mouth near the lower center shows a row of white rectangular teeth; loose multicolored lines—yellow, cyan, magenta, green—scatter across the entire surface in overlapping layers.
reading: The heart placed where eyes would normally sit creates a collision between tenderness and aggression: the crossed yellow bars read as damage or cancellation, yet the shape itself is unmistakably affectionate. Below it, the bared teeth pull in the opposite direction. The gray ground keeps the dense color from feeling celebratory, holding the image in something closer to tension than triumph.

title: nnxyz nnotb #163
observations: A rounded head shape fills most of the canvas against a flat purple border; the left eye socket holds a red crosshatched form topped with spiky yellow lines, while the right holds a pink spiral coil.
The face is built from overlapping olive, ochre, and brown washes, with loose multicolored lines—blue, teal, red, white—running across the surface in no single direction.
A wide open mouth near the lower center shows white vertical marks suggesting teeth, outlined in blue and black, with yellow and teal lines trailing below it.
reading: Two mismatched eye forms—one a red grid, one a pink spiral—sit inside a broadly modeled head that reads as unsettled rather than composed. The surrounding lines do not describe anatomy so much as crowd it, pulling attention outward even as the face holds the center. The open mouth and asymmetric eyes together suggest exposure or alarm, though the warm ochre ground keeps that reading from tipping into pure distress.

title: nnxyz rawblocks #61
observations: A large skull-like form fills the center, built from heavy black outlines with rows of white teeth along a wide-open lower jaw and a smaller yellow-jawed shape protruding to the right.
Two circular eye sockets are ringed in bright magenta, each containing concentric black spirals with small red marks at their centers, giving them a target-like look.
A teal-green background is layered with loose blue, yellow, and pink marks, while a sharp coral-red diagonal line cuts across the upper right quadrant.
reading: Two mouths compete for attention: a gaping lower jaw lined with blunt white teeth and a snapping yellow shape bristling with pointed ones. The magenta-ringed eyes stare outward like mismatched lenses, one slightly higher than the other, lending the whole form a lopsided watchfulness. Against the cool teal field, orange and pink slashes feel like heat escaping from inside the skull. The image reads as both fierce and absurd, a form caught mid-shout.

title: nnxyz nnotb #51
observations: A solid black four-legged animal sits on a flat black shelf against a burnt-orange field; its outline is traced with a thin orange-gold edge line.
Two spiral-coiled yellow-green circles serve as eyes; two small white triangular points mark the mouth area below them.
Loose yellow zigzag and wavy lines radiate across the entire orange background, denser near the upper left and sparser toward the right edge.
reading: The black figure holds the center with a flat, cut-out weight, while the radiating yellow lines give the surrounding field a charged, almost vibrating quality. The spiral eyes read as wide alertness rather than calm, and the white points below them add a faintly unsettling edge. Orange and black together push the mood toward heat and tension rather than warmth.

title: nnxyz nnotb #27
observations: A dark, roughly humanoid figure sits low and forward, its wide-open mouth showing white teeth outlined in red, with two red-streaked eye sockets above.
Splayed feather-like forms spread from both sides of the figure's upper body — built from overlapping white, orange, and black lines rather than solid fill.
The background is a soft grey-brown gradient with blurred circular light patches, placing the scribbled figure against a diffuse, almost foggy field.
reading: The figure crouches and opens wide, teeth bared, red bleeding into the eye sockets and mouth rim. That red reads as alarm against the dark body. The feathered forms spreading from its shoulders soften the threat slightly — they could be wings or just the energy of the lines escaping outward. The blurred background pushes the figure forward without anchoring it to any specific place.

title: nnxyz nnotb #209
observations: A roughly circular head form fills most of the canvas against a dark grey ground, with spiky black marks radiating outward along the top and sides.
The left eye area contains a tight inward spiral of blue and yellow lines nested inside a square-cornered outline; the right side shows overlapping triangular red and white lines on a pink field.
The lower third is dominated by a wide-open mouth showing a row of grey-white rectangular teeth, outlined and cross-hatched in black, with red and yellow scribbled lines running beneath the jaw.
reading: The face pushes to the edges of the frame, its two eye zones built from opposite geometries — a coiling spiral on the left, a jagged triangular tangle on the right. That asymmetry reads as unease rather than balance. The bared teeth below carry enough solidity to feel like a fixed state rather than a passing expression. Loose marks at the crown and sides keep the whole form from settling.

title: nnxyz nnotb #172
observations: A rounded, bulging form fills most of the dark teal background; its surface is layered with short, crossing lines in red, yellow, green, blue, and purple over a dominant olive-green mass.
Two eye sockets hold white triangular highlights against dark recesses, and a wide open mouth below shows white teeth separated by black vertical lines, with a thick red lip line curving around it.
Loose scribbled lines in neon colors—cyan, magenta, yellow—radiate outward from the central form without resolving into recognizable objects, sitting on top of the heavier underlying shapes.
reading: The face pushes forward, its swollen volume pressing against the frame. Crossed scribbles in acid yellow and cyan sit over the olive bulk without softening it, and the bared teeth read as confrontational rather than joyful. The white highlights in the eye sockets create two points of sharp contrast that hold attention against the surrounding noise. The dark teal field keeps the whole thing from dispersing.

title: nnxyz nnotb #185
observations: A large frontal face structure fills most of the black ground, built from stacked rectangular zones — brow, eye sockets, and a wide open lower jaw — outlined in heavy black with yellow infill.

The right eye socket contains a dense blue grid of parallel vertical lines inside a dark square frame; the left eye is a smaller rounded recess with a spiral curl at center, creating clear asymmetry between the two sides.
Loose lines in sky blue, magenta, red, and white arc across the black background and over the face, some forming repeating zigzag or wave bands, others trailing freely beyond the figure's edges.
reading: Against a flat black ground, a face built from hard rectangular blocks holds the frame with a wide tooth-filled jaw and mismatched eyes — one gridded, one coiled. The surrounding lines do not stay behind the figure; they cross it, loop past it, and press in from every edge. The rigid geometry of the face sits in tension with the loose arcing lines that refuse to stay in place, giving the image a quality that is both fixed and restless.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #15
observations: A roughly oval head fills the center against a flat hot-pink background; five pointed spike shapes rise from the top edge, rendered in teal, white, and green lines.

Two eye zones are built from sharp triangular and diamond outlines in white and yellow, with deep red fill visible inside each, creating hard angular contrast against surrounding dense cross-hatched marks.

The lower face carries a wide open mouth outlined in pink and red, showing blocky tooth forms; the entire head surface is layered with short overlapping strokes in black, lime green, orange, teal, and brown.
reading: The flat pink field holds the head at a fixed distance, giving it nowhere to recede. Inside that stillness the surface is anything but quiet: dense cross-hatched strokes in green, orange, and black press against each other without resolving into smooth form. The angular eye shapes read as confrontational—not because the face scowls, but because hard geometry inside soft scribble creates a visual standoff. The open mouth adds a second point of tension without tipping into legible expression.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #7
observations: Two large square frames, each enclosing concentric oval rings and a tight black spiral at center, sit side by side on a lime-green face mass against a saturated red background.
A wide open mouth spans the lower third of the face, filled with thick white triangular teeth outlined in teal and red, with dark shadow gaps between each tooth.
Dense overlapping scribble layers in yellow, teal, white, and black cover the upper head area, with looser teal outline loops extending beyond the face into the red field on all sides.
reading: The squared eye-frames give the face a mask-like flatness, while the spiral centers pull attention inward against that rigidity. The bared teeth read as a grin stretched past comfort—suspended between delight and unease rather than settled at either. Scribbled color above and around the face functions less as hair or background and more like noise crowding the edges of a signal. The red field holds everything at high pressure.

title: nnxyz nnotb #173
observations: A large oval outline drawn in white frames a dense layered face-like form against a flat bright blue field; the oval sits slightly left of center.
Two inset shapes occupy the eye positions: a red heart pierced by a white bar on the left, and a yellow-green flower with a looped center on the right, each enclosed in its own rectangular boundary.

A wide open mouth near the bottom shows alternating black and white rectangular teeth under a pink zigzag lip line; loose yellow, black, and white scribble lines extend beyond the oval into all four corners.
reading: The face-like structure feels almost festive rather than threatening: a heart and a flower standing in for eyes give the layered form an oddly tender quality, even as the bared teeth and dense overlapping lines push toward agitation. The flat blue field keeps everything readable, holding the internal density at a distance. Two moods coexist without resolving.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #35
observations: A broad yellow rectangle frames the composition on three sides, enclosing a dense grid of smaller rectangles stacked vertically to suggest a face structure.

Three tightly wound spiral forms appear across the upper and middle zones — one in the upper-left panel, one large central spiral, and one in the upper-right panel — each layered in yellow, red, blue, and black rings.
A horizontal band near the lower third contains a zigzag black line running across a pink and white field, flanked above and below by thick yellow borders, reading as a wide open mouth.
reading: Yellow scaffolding holds the face structure together like a frame within a frame, while three spirals pull the eye inward at different depths. The zigzag mouth band sits flat and wide, more mechanical than expressive. A small red loop at the left edge sits apart from the main structure, quieter than the surrounding density. The image reads as confrontational — more like a fixed stare than an outburst.

title: nnxyz rawblocks #49
observations: A wide-open mouth dominates the lower half, showing two rows of blocky white teeth against a deep red interior, framed by heavy black and white outlines.
Multiple red heart shapes cluster across the upper face area, overlapping tangled cyan, magenta, and yellow scribble lines that fill the space between two mismatched eye forms.
A flat teal background occupies the right side and upper-right corner, interrupted by black ink blots and a yellow spiral, creating stark contrast with the dense linework of the central form.
reading: The mouth commands the composition—its red cavity and squared-off teeth pull focus downward while scattered heart shapes above read as frantic rather than tender. One eye socket glows orange-yellow; the other hides behind a yellow bar, giving the face an asymmetry that feels unstable. The teal ground offers breathing room, but black pooling at the edges presses inward, tightening the space around the head. The result can feel like a shout caught between affection and alarm.

title: nnxyz nnotb #236
observations: A large frontal head shape dominates the center, with two circular eye forms filled with dense hatched lines — one square-ish in yellow and black, one round with a red X over blue and orange.
Jagged crown-like points rise along the top edge in black and yellow, flanked by orange and green drips running down from the upper border.

The lower third shows a wide open mouth form in dark red with white horizontal lines suggesting teeth, set against a gray background crossed by yellow scribble lines and a small artist mark in the lower right.
reading: The face pushes forward on a gray field, its two mismatched eyes — one gridded, one crossed out — giving the image an off-balance stare that reads as confrontational or unsettled. Drips from the top border and the open-toothed mouth below pull the eye up and down at once. Scrawled lines layered over flat color blocks create a surface that feels both raw and packed.

title: Scrimshaw7
observations: A pink-lavender spiral sits upper-left on the head, with radiating dark, red, and gray lines fanning outward across the full width of the image.
Two large oval eye shapes contain concentric rings of green, purple, and white, flanking a vertical teal stripe running down the center of the face.
A wide open mouth at the bottom shows jagged white triangular teeth between red lips, with scattered angular purple and pink marks filling the surrounding background.
reading: The face stares out through layered rings of color, its spiral crown pulling the eye upward while bared teeth anchor the composition below. The teal stripe splits the image into halves that don't quite mirror each other—one eye wider, one more buried in overlapping lines. The effect reads as alarm or confrontation, a face caught mid-shout against clashing yellows, pinks, and blues.

title: nnxyz rawblocks #55
observations: A wide-open mouth fills the lower center, lined with white rectangular teeth outlined in black, bordered by deep red and dripping marks beneath the lower lip.
A single large eye sits left of center with concentric gold-and-black rings inside a white almond outline, surrounded by tangled blue, yellow, and red scribbles.
Thin neon-yellow, green, and red lines scatter across the top and right edges, floating above a muted brown-gray ground that darkens toward the corners.
reading: The face is almost all mouth and one staring eye—an imbalance that can read as alarm or a shout caught mid-breath. Heavy black outlines hold the form together while thin colored lines break free at every edge, as if the figure is dissolving into its own noise. Teal and red patches bleed through the scribble layers, lending the brown ground unexpected warmth. The rigid white teeth anchor the composition against the surrounding tangle.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #81
observations: A large rounded head shape sits against a flat saturated yellow background, its surface covered in overlapping lines in green, blue, red, purple, gray, and black that leave almost no white area unpatterned.
Two eye sockets are outlined in thick green loops; each contains a white rectangle with a short red horizontal mark at center, giving both eyes the same flat, forward-facing quality.
A wide open mouth near the bottom shows a row of white rectangular teeth outlined in black, framed by a red lip line, with the lower jaw visibly offset slightly left of the face's vertical center.
reading: Dense overlapping lines in many colors pack the face's surface until the underlying form reads more as a container than a volume. The two eyes, identical in their red-mark-on-white construction, suggest a mask worn rather than a face inhabited. That wide tooth-filled mouth reads as a grin or a grimace depending on how long you look — the yellow field around it stays warm and loud, refusing to settle the question.

title: nnxyz nnotb #47
observations: A four-limbed figure fills most of the frame, arms raised and splayed outward, built from dense overlapping loops of white, yellow, red, blue, and black line against a grey wave-patterned background.
The face is the darkest zone: two large square eye sockets hold concentric rings of red, yellow, and white, and a wide open mouth shows a row of sharp white teeth outlined heavily in black.
A cast shadow falls directly behind the figure onto the grey background, and a faint red partial arc is visible in the upper right corner, partially obscured by the dark edge.
reading: The figure throws its limbs outward in all directions, and the tangled lines building its body feel loose and agitated against the smoother grey waves behind it. The face anchors the chaos: squared eye sockets and an open-toothed mouth read as alarm or a shout. The shadow doubles the form without repeating its color, adding a quieter second presence beneath the noise.

title: nnxyz nnotb #210
observations: A roughly circular form dominates the center against a dark blue-grey ground, built from overlapping white outlines and dense black scribble layers, with a wide open lower section filled with vertical white strokes.
A tight spiral of red, orange, and yellow lines coils in the upper-right area of the central form, drawing the eye inward; a horizontal yellow band cuts across the middle-left of the form.

Lines in teal, red, white, yellow, and magenta extend outward from the central form in all directions, some ending in sharp zigzag bursts, others trailing into loose scribbles against the flat ground.
reading: The circular form holds together under pressure from lines pulling outward in every direction. The coiled spiral reads as a point of concentrated tension, while the open lower section—white verticals packed inside a dark cavity—suggests something between a shout and a grimace. The flat dark ground keeps the outward energy from dissolving; the image feels caught mid-release.

title: nnxyz nnotb #181
observations: A roughly square head-like form sits centered on a flat yellow field, outlined in thick black with a white inner contour; two diamond-shaped red-filled forms occupy the upper interior as eye-like zones.
A wide open mouth area in the lower half shows white tooth-like shapes outlined in red and black, with pink and dark-red lines looping across the chin region.
Across the top edge, a black zigzag band and a separate sawtooth arc run horizontally, while thin cyan, white, and green looping lines scatter across the interior and yellow ground.
reading: Saturated yellow pushes the central form forward, making the dense interior feel compressed rather than spacious. The two red diamond shapes read as eyes locked open, and the bared tooth forms below carry a rawness that sits somewhere between a shout and a grimace. Loose cyan and white loops drift across the surface, softening the aggression without resolving it.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #125
observations: A dark, rounded head-like form sits against a flat lavender field; two large hands grip the top edge, fingers splayed, framing the upper mass.
The left eye socket holds a gold oval with a vertical drip line; the right socket contains a tight yellow spiral ringed by dark coiling lines, creating two visually distinct focal points.
Dense multicolored scribble lines—teal, pink, yellow, black—layer over dark brown-black volumes, with white highlight spots on the lower teeth and a wide open mouth below center.
reading: Two mismatched eyes anchor a face that reads as both mask and object: one a flat gold shape with a dripping line, the other a wound-tight spiral. Hands gripping the skull from above add a sense of something held or displayed rather than simply present. The lavender ground keeps the dark form cool and slightly suspended, while the scribble lines give the surface a restless quality beneath the solid volumes.

title: nnxyz nnotb #30
observations: A wide-brimmed hat in yellow and orange sits atop a boxy torso; the figure stands centered on a flat teal ground with arms spread wide and claw-like hands at each side.
White and pink lines trace a ribcage pattern across the chest, layered over vertical stripes of magenta, yellow, and red that fill the rectangular body block.
The face shows a wide open-toothed grin in black and white lines, framed by a gray rectangle that sits between the head and the hat brim.
reading: The figure plants itself squarely in the frame, arms out, grin exposed—a posture that reads as confrontational or theatrical depending on how long you look. The ribcage drawn over the bright torso stripes gives the body a see-through quality, as if surface and interior compete for the same space. The flat teal ground offers no depth, keeping all that color tension at the front.

title: nnxyz #20
observations: A wide-brimmed olive and yellow cap dominates the upper half; its crown carries a small dark emblem drawn in blocky marks against the yellow-green fill.
The face below the cap is built from overlapping white loops and red vertical stripes on a dark grey ground, with two squinting eye shapes and a wide open-tooth mouth.
At lower left, loose purple marks form rough letter-like shapes; at lower right, a skeletal hand grips a thin dark rod that rises vertically.
reading: A figure assembled from competing layers: the cap reads as solid and weighted while the face beneath dissolves into white scribble and red stripe. The open-tooth mouth and narrowed eyes sit in tension — one reads as a shout, the other as a squint. Purple marks at the edge feel like an overflow, as if the image kept going past its own boundary.

title: Scrimshaw3
observations: Three rounded forms outlined in thick black strokes sit side by side, with looping lines suggesting circular eyes, ears, and wide-open mouths across the lower half.
A dense underlayer of orange, teal, blue, red, and pink scratchy lines fills the background, visible through and around the black outlines like a tangled web.
Bold white scrawled marks cut across the middle zone, overlapping the black forms and creating a loose scribble layer that partially obscures the shapes beneath.
reading: Three black-outlined heads crowd the frame shoulder to shoulder, their features reduced to loops and open curves. Behind them, a hot orange-and-purple field of tangled lines pulses through every gap. The white scrawl layered across their faces reads as interruption—obscuring mouths and eyes, lending the group a feeling of being spoken over or half-erased. The composition can feel both communal and chaotic, figures jostling for visibility.

title: nnxyz nifty faces #110
observations: A wide open mouth with visible teeth dominates the lower center, surrounded by dense black hatching that builds jaw and cheek planes against a flat burnt-orange background.
A cluster of pointed yellow-gold forms rises at the upper left above the brow line; orange and red lines reinforce their sharp, outward-radiating edges.
Thin lines in cyan, pink, white, and red scatter across the face and beyond the head's boundary, while black cross-hatching concentrates mass at the center.
reading: The tooth-filled mouth and the spiky yellow-gold forms at the brow pull against each other — one open and releasing, the other sharp and upward-pointing. Dense black hatching builds weight at the face's core while cyan and pink lines escape outward, giving a feeling of pressure finding edges. The flat orange ground holds everything close to the surface, with nowhere to recede.

title: nnxyz nnotb #248
observations: A dark olive-green four-legged figure stands upright at center, its rounded head enclosed by a thin circular outline, with red crossed lines layered over both eye areas.
A looped pink-and-blue line forms a collar shape at the figure's neck; yellow outlines trace the feet and a rectangular patch on the lower torso.
The background carries broad tan and cream washes overlaid with orange-yellow blocks upper left, teal horizontal strokes, loose black spirals, and red-orange shapes lower right.
reading: A dark upright figure holds the frame, its face crossed with red lines that read as both decoration and obstruction. The thin circle around the head separates it from a busy background without fully enclosing it. The pink-blue collar introduces a softer note against the olive and black mass. Something between display and unease sits in that combination of adornment and crossed-out eyes.
